steps.d: In the studio, go to Settings and open Educator Profile.
Upload a cover and logo, then set your display name and handle.
Write a few lines about your academy and pick the kind of coaching you do.
Add your website, YouTube, Instagram and X, and turn on the video watermark.
Save, and the changes show on your public page straight away.

faq.q: How do I start my own online coaching academy?
faq.a: Sign up on AllCoaching, choose a plan, set up your brand in Settings › Educator Profile, then upload a course and start selling. Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial, no card needed.

faq.q: How do I add my logo and profile?
faq.a: In Settings › Educator Profile, upload your logo and cover, fill in your display name, handle, about and category, and save. Changes show on your public page as soon as you save.

faq.q: Can I use my own domain?
faq.a: Yes. Every academy gets a free .allcoaching.in address, and you can connect your own domain on every plan. You buy the domain from any registrar, and connecting it is free.

faq.q: How do I put my watermark on my videos?
faq.a: Turn on Video watermark in your Educator Profile, drag your logo to where you want it and pick small, medium or large. It is added to videos you upload from then on and can’t be removed from a video later.

faq.q: What does the category in my profile change?
faq.a: It sets the course categories and suggested tags you see when you add courses, videos and PDFs, and the filters on your Courses list.
